# NES.css Design System — full component reference

> Retro 8-bit React design system built on NES.css. Import the stylesheet once (styles/nes.css), then use the typed components below. Visual variation only via props (variant, size, state, dark, rounded).

## NesButton

The primary action control. A native <button> with a 4px pixel border and stepped hover/active shadows.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesButton

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| variant | "default" \| "primary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error" | — | Semantic color. |
| disabled | boolean | — | Native disabled state. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesBadge

Small pixel label for counts and statuses; optionally split with an icon half.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesBadge

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| variant | "dark" \| "primary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error" | — | Fill color. |
| href | string | — | Optional link target. |
| icon / iconVariant | ReactNode / variant | — | Splits the badge with an icon half. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesBalloon

Speech balloon for dialogue text with a pixel tail on the left or right.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesBalloon

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| from | "left" \| "right" | — | Tail side. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesContainer

Framed panel with an optional title that sits on the border. The main grouping surface.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesContainer

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| title | string | — | Border caption. |
| dark / rounded / centered | boolean | — | Visual modifiers. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesDialog

Native <dialog> styled as a pixel panel; buttons inside a method=dialog form close it.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesDialog

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| open | boolean | — | Open on mount. |
| dark / rounded | boolean | — | Visual modifiers. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesField

Label + control wrapper that keeps the accessible name wired.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesField

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| label | string | — | Visible label. |
| htmlFor | string | — | Id of the control. |
| inline | boolean | — | Label beside the control. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesInput

Text input with a pixel frame and semantic validation variants.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesInput

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| state | "success" \| "warning" \| "error" | — | Validation color. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesTextarea

Multi-line sibling of NesInput with the same frame and variants.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesTextarea

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| dark | boolean | — | Inverted colors. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesCheckbox

Checkbox drawn from pixel box-shadows, with the label baked in.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesCheckbox

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| label | ReactNode | — | Required visible label. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesRadio

Radio button with a pixel dot; group by name.

|---|---|---|---|
| label | string | — | Visible label. |

| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

Native select wrapped in a pixel frame with a drawn arrow.

Unordered list with pixel disc or circle markers.

## NesProgress

Native <progress> in a pixel frame with semantic fills.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesProgress

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| value / max | number | — | Progress amount. |
| variant | "default" \| "primary" \| "success" \| "warning" \| "error" \| "pattern" | — | Fill color or striped texture. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

Bordered data table with pixel cell dividers.

|---|---|---|---|
| bordered / centered / dark / responsive | boolean | — | Visual modifiers. |

| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesText

Inline text colored with a semantic token.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesText

|---|---|---|---|

| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesAvatar

Pixelated avatar image in four fixed sizes.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesAvatar

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| size | "small" \| "medium" \| "large" | — | Fixed pixel size. |
| rounded | boolean | — | Pixel-round crop. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesIcon

Built-in NES icon set (hearts, stars, coins, social marks) drawn from box-shadows.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesIcon

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | NesIconName | — | Icon id. |
| size | "small" \| "medium" \| "large" | — | Fixed size. |
| empty | boolean | — | Outline variant (heart/star). |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesPixelArt

Large pixel sprites (characters, devices, logos) at their drawn size.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesPixelArt

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | NesPixelArtName | — | Sprite id. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesRuneIcon

215 monochrome pixel glyphs that fill with currentColor.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesRuneIcon

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| name | RuneIconName | — | Glyph id (see RUNE_ICONS). |
| size | "small" \| "medium" \| "large" | — | Fixed size. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |

## NesPixelIcon

Renders icons drawn in the Icon studio from grid data; palette colors or monochrome currentColor.

Spec: https://design.2.MikeDemo.dev/specs/NesPixelIcon

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
|---|---|---|---|
| icon | PixelIconData | — | Grid + palette from the studio export. |
| size | "small" \| "medium" \| "large" | — | Fixed size. |
| monochrome | boolean | — | Ignore the palette and use currentColor. |
| className | string | — | Merged with the NES classes. |
| ref | Ref | — | Forwarded to the underlying element. |
